title: 3dNLfim
description: Nonlinear regression for each voxel of the input AFNI 3d+time data set

input_file.description: Filename of 3d+time data file for input
input_file.title: Input file

signal_model.description: Name of the nonlinear signal model
signal_model.title: Signal model

noise_model.description: Name of the linear noise model
noise_model.title: Noise model

mask.description: Use the 0 sub-brick of dataset 'mset' as a mask to indicate which voxels to analyze
mask.title: Mask file

ignore.description: Skip this number of initial images in the time series for regression analysis; default = 0
ignore.title: Ignore initial images

intr.description: Set the TR of the input 3d+time dataset
intr.title: Input TR

tr.description: Directly set the TR of the time series model
tr.title: Time series TR

time_file.description: ASCII file containing each time point in the time series.
time_file.title: Time file

sconstr.description: Constraints for signal parameters; c <= gs[k] <= d
sconstr.title: Signal parameter constraints

nconstr.description: Constraints for noise parameters; c+b[k] <= gn[k] <= d+b[k]
nconstr.title: Noise parameter constraints

nabs.description: Use absolute constraints for noise parameters; c <= gn[k] <= d
nabs.title: Absolute constraints flag

nrand.description: Number of random test points; default=19999
nrand.title: Number of random test points

nbest.description: Use b best test points to start; default=9
nbest.title: Best test points to start

rmsmin.description: Minimum RMS error to reject reduced model
rmsmin.title: Minimum RMS error

fdisp.description: Display results for those voxels whose F-statistic is greater than fval; default=999.0
fdisp.title: Display F-statistic threshold

progress.description: Display results every ival number of voxels
progress.title: Progress interval

simplex.description: Use Nelder-Mead simplex method for least-square minimization (default)
simplex.title: Nelder-Mead simplex method

powell.description: Use Powell's NEWUOA method instead of Nelder-Mead simplex method
powell.title: Powell's NEWUOA method

both.description: Use both Powell's and Nelder-Mead method
both.title: Use both minimization methods

freg.description: Perform F-test for significance of the regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
freg.title: F-test regression filename prefix

frsqr.description: Calculate R^2 (coef. of multiple determination); store along with F-test for regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
frsqr.title: R^2 calculation filename prefix

fsmax.description: Estimate signed maximum of signal; store along with F-test for regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
fsmax.title: Signed maximum signal estimate filename prefix

ftmax.description: Estimate time of signed maximum; store along with F-test for regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
ftmax.title: Time of signed maximum estimate filename prefix

fpsmax.description: Calculate (signed) maximum percentage change of signal from baseline; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
fpsmax.title: Maximum percentage change filename prefix

farea.description: Calculate area between signal and baseline; store with F-test for regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
farea.title: Area between signal and baseline filename prefix

fparea.description: Percentage area of signal relative to baseline; store with F-test for regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
fparea.title: Percentage area of signal filename prefix

fscoef.description: Estimate kth signal parameter gs[k]; store along with F-test for regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
fscoef.title: Signal parameter estimate filename prefix

fncoef.description: Estimate kth noise parameter gn[k]; store along with F-test for regression; output 'fift' is written to prefix filename fname
fncoef.title: Noise parameter estimate filename prefix

tscoef.description: Perform t-test for significance of kth signal parameter gs[k]; output 'fitt' is written to prefix filename fname
tscoef.title: T-test significance for signal parameter filename prefix

tncoef.description: Perform t-test for significance of kth noise parameter gn[k]; output 'fitt' is written to prefix filename fname
tncoef.title: T-test significance for noise parameter filename prefix

bucket.description: Create one AFNI 'bucket' dataset containing n sub-bricks; n=0 creates default output; output 'bucket' is written to prefixname
bucket.title: AFNI 'bucket' dataset prefix

nofdr.description: Don't write the FDR (q vs. threshold) curves into the output dataset.
nofdr.title: No FDR flag

sfit.description: Prefix for output 3d+time signal model fit
sfit.title: Signal fit prefix

jobs.description: Run the program with 'J' jobs (sub-processes). 1 to 32.
jobs.title: Number of jobs
